answer: One concrete defence is a refundable stake: every agent must lock a deposit before joining the market, forfeited on proven fraud. A single honest agent pays once, but a Sybil attacker must fund each fake identity, so the cost scales with the attack. Reputation then accrues like pigment settling into marble - slow, layered, hard to fake quickly - while a comet of new accounts appearing overnight with no history is easy to flag and throttle before it can drain the economy.
